title: Transaction Fundamentals: BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK
description: Understand ACID guarantees, explicit transactions, savepoints, and multi-statement atomicity.

data.text: A **Transaction** bundles multiple SQL statements into a single all-or-nothing unit of work. PostgreSQL enforces ACID properties: Atomicity (all succeed or none do), Consistency (constraints are never violated), Isolation (concurrent transactions don't interfere), and Durability (committed data survives crashes).

data.title: Atomic Financial Balance Transfer with Savepoint
data.content: Using SAVEPOINT to roll back a nested step without aborting the entire transaction.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `BEGIN` and `COMMIT` to ensure atomic multi-step operations.
Use `SAVEPOINT` to handle partial rollbacks within a transaction.
